build_dm_tree_package: build the dm-tree pip package using CMake to compile the C++ extension module
create_cmake_extension: create a CMakeExtension with no sources for CMake-based compilation of the _tree module
build_cmake_extension_module: build a CMakeExtension using BuildCMakeExtension to compile with CMake instead of a bare compiler
test_build_environment: test the build environment by checking for CMake, C++ compiler, and Python development files
summarize_setup_configuration: summarize the setuptools.setup configuration for the dm-tree package including dependencies and classifiers
